comparisons.peer_summary: Government incentives related to capital expenditures reduced property, plant, and equipment by $2.34 billion as of August 29, 2024, including $1.10 billion for 2024 expenditures.
comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Micron disclose specific capital expenditure-related commitments or impacts within their financial notes. Intel reports aggregate capital expenditure commitments of $20.0 billion as of year-end 2024, with a majority due in the next 12 months. Similarly, Micron discloses the impact of government incentives on its capital expenditure assets, noting that these incentives reduced property, plant, and equipment by $2.34 billion as of August 2024, including $1.10 billion specifically for 2024 expenditures. Both disclosures relate to the scale and financial structuring of capital spending, though Intel focuses on forward-looking contractual obligations while Micron focuses on the net asset value reduction from subsidies.
